reference_sql:
WITH tagged AS (
  -- one row per event of 1 to 7 November 2025 (Dublin days), with its ga_session_id read out
  SELECT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
), per_id AS (
  -- one row per ga_session_id: how many visitors hold it; an event missing either ID belongs to no session
  SELECT ga_session_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS visitors
  FROM tagged
  WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS id_values, SUM(visitors) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visitors > 1) AS shared_ids
FROM per_id

  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), per_id AS (
  -- one row per ga_session_id: the sessions that share it
  SELECT ga_session_id, COUNT(*) AS visitors
  FROM pairs
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ga_session_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS id_values, SUM(visitors) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visitors > 1) AS shared_ids
FROM per_id

WITH pairs AS (
  -- one row per session: each distinct user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id of 1 to 7 November 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) FROM pairs WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL) AS id_values,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pairs WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL) AS sessions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (/* one row per shared ga_session_id */ SELECT ga_session_id FROM pairs WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ga_session_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS shared) AS shared_ids

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT user_pseudo_id, list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_date BETWEEN '20251101' AND '20251107' AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), ev2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id FROM ev WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
), per_id AS (
  SELECT ga_session_id, COUNT(*) AS visitors FROM ev2 GROUP BY ga_session_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS id_values, SUM(visitors)::BIGINT AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visitors >= 2) AS shared_ids
FROM per_id
